name_editor._note: Name Editor (name_editor.gd), in editor pixels: drawn in its own SubViewport at the largest whole scale at which the panel fits max_fill of the safe area. Buttons and arrows are at least min_target_css tall on touch screens (about 1 cm).

needs_hud._note: Hunger / thirst bars in the top-left of the safe area. Drawn in hud pixels of about hud_px_css CSS px each (whole device px). bar_px = bar size incl. its 1 px outline; pulse_hz when under needs.low.

gait._note: Soft footsteps (audio.json footsteps): beats as [stride phase 0..1, paw]; a stride = the sprite's frames x stride_px (cats.json fern walk / run), so beats follow the drawn legs. offset shifts every beat.

travel._note: Walking into an exit: fade to black over fade_s, load the other area at the spawn the exit names, fade back in.

den._note: Den interiors (scripts/core/den_layout.gd): floor sizes per size name (walls go round them), wall thickness, rounded corners, the doorway width, nests (size, gap, distance from the back wall; nest_radius = the 'Your nest.' interact range), decor slots every decor_every px (decor_clear px from nests), the inside spawn's x offset from the doorway, the worn trail's width, and how far the camera may show past the walls (border, drawn with forest_art).

collapse._note: Hunger or thirst at 0: Fern sinks down (lie_s), the screen fades to black (fade_s), the message (strings.json collapse.message) shows until a tap / key (after min_message_s) or message_s, then she wakes at recovery_area / recovery_spawn with needs.restore_* and stretches (wake_s) before control comes back.

hunt._note: Hunting (scripts/core/hunt_tuning.gd; exported on the Hunting autoload). Alert is 0..1: rises per second by look_rise (Fern moves while the head is up), walk_rise (moves uncrouched within noise_px), close_rise (moves uncrouched within close_px); falls by alert_fall while she holds still. Ranges are [min, max] seconds.

patrol._note: Border patrols: mark_s = seconds Fern spends leaving a scent mark (movement locked).
